tools.name: ask_imagery
tools.label: Ask the satellite specialist
tools.description: Ask the imagery specialist what the satellite shows on a field: where the problem area is and its shape. Returns evidence items. Pass the field id from list_fields.

tools.name: ask_environment
tools.label: Ask the weather and soil specialist
tools.description: Ask the environment specialist whether weather, hail, drought, soil or terrain explain the stress. Returns evidence items. Pass the field id from list_fields.

tools.name: ask_agronomy
tools.label: Ask the crop health specialist
tools.description: Ask the agronomy specialist about disease and pest reports and field history. Returns evidence items. Pass the field id from list_fields.

tools.name: list_fields
tools.label: Your fields
tools.description: List every field on the farm with its id, the name the farmer uses, crop and acres.

tools.name: get_field_context
tools.label: Field history, terrain, water, prices
tools.description: Everything static about a field: soil, terrain, mapped water (flood zones, streams, wetlands), crop history, neighbors, economics.

tools.name: send_farmer_message
tools.label: Text the farmer (no YES needed)
tools.description: Text a person on the farm (no approval needed). Plain words, under ~300 characters, no emoji, the field name the farmer uses. person_id from the farm's people (the farmer is the default). urgency: low, actionable or urgent (urgent skips quiet hours).

tools.name: list_fields
tools.label: Your fields

tools.name: look_at_field
tools.label: Latest satellite photos
tools.description: Pull the latest cloud-free satellite pass over a field and LOOK at it.

tools.name: get_scene_analysis
tools.label: Satellite check results
tools.description: Pre-computed analysis of the latest satellite pass, if the pipeline has run for this field.

tools.name: analyze_field
tools.label: Problem areas from the satellite check
tools.description: Deterministic analysis of the latest clear scene on or before as_of: masked indices, baseline and change z-scores, problem regions with pattern features, gates.

tools.name: get_index_history
tools.label: Crop health over the season
tools.description: Crop-health index (ndvi, ndre or ndmi) per clear satellite pass for a field, with the same-weeks-in-prior-seasons expectation and z; adds the problem region's median when region_id is given.

tools.name: compare_to_cohort
tools.label: Crop health vs. same-crop fields
tools.description: Field crop health vs same-crop neighbor fields on the same pass, as of a date. Returns status no_cohort (not an error) when there are no neighbors.

tools.name: test_overlap
tools.label: Problem area vs. low spots, sand, edges
tools.description: How much of a problem region lies on a layer (field_edge, pivot_ring, lowspot, soil_sandy, hail_swath), the share expected by chance, and a p-value.

tools.name: get_hail

tools.name: get_drought

tools.description: US Drought Monitor category for a county as of a date.

tools.description: Soil map units for a field from NRCS Soil Data Access.

tools.name: precheck_evidence
tools.label: Check what we already know
tools.description: FIRST STEP. Score the precomputed evidence for this field (pattern analysis and open watches). If the answer is decisive the result says fast_path true: skip the specialists and go to impact.

tools.name: score_hypotheses
tools.label: Turn evidence into percents
tools.description: Score every piece of evidence gathered so far. Call it after the specialists answer, and again if new evidence arrives. Returns each condition's percent and status, how_sure wording and close_call. Use ONLY these numbers and this wording for how sure we are.

tools.name: estimate_impact
tools.label: Dollar range at stake
tools.description: Dollar range at stake for the likely condition on the affected acres, from published loss tables. condition is a condition id from the score result. Pass crop, expected_yield and price from the field when you know them. Use these dollar figures as given.

tools.name: create_work_order
tools.label: Repair ticket with a map pin
tools.description: Send a repair work order with a map pin to the person who does repairs. Requires farmer approval.
tools.gate: Needs the farmer's YES (recorded by code, not the AI)

tools.name: create_scout_pin
tools.label: Scouting pin for the field
tools.description: Drop a scouting pin with coordinates and what to look for. Requires farmer approval.
tools.gate: Needs the farmer's YES (recorded by code, not the AI)

sources.name: FieldWatch farm records
sources.gives: Fields, crops, acres and the people on the farm
used_by: Problem area vs. low spots, sand, edges

sources.name: FieldWatch satellite check (stored)
sources.gives: Latest pre-computed weak-spot analysis per field, from the scene pipeline

sources.name: Sentinel-2 satellite (Element 84 Earth Search)
sources.gives: Cloud-free images and crop-health index (NDVI, NDRE, NDMI) at 10 m pixels
used_by: Problem areas from the satellite check

sources.name: Open-Meteo weather archive
sources.gives: Daily rain and max temperature for the last 30 days at the field

sources.name: NOAA MRMS radar hail
sources.gives: Largest hail size (MESH, mm) over the field, per day, on a 0.01-degree grid

sources.name: NOAA SPC storm reports
sources.gives: Hail reports within 10 km of the field

sources.name: U.S. Drought Monitor
sources.gives: Drought category for the county (the worst one covering at least half of it)

sources.name: USDA NRCS Soil Data Access (SSURGO)
sources.gives: Soil map areas, texture, available water, sandy share and drainage
used_by: Problem area vs. low spots, sand, edges

sources.name: USGS 3DEP elevation
sources.gives: 1 m elevation: low spots and slope inside the field
used_by: Problem area vs. low spots, sand, edges

sources.name: FEMA flood maps (NFHL)
sources.gives: Mapped flood zones that touch the field

sources.name: USDA Crop Sequence Boundaries 2018-2025
sources.gives: Crop history for the drawn field

sources.name: USDA NASS Quick Stats
sources.gives: County median yield and national price; FieldWatch planning defaults when missing

sources.name: EDDMapS disease and pest reports
sources.gives: County disease and pest confirmations for the season

sources.name: FieldWatch loss tables
sources.gives: Yield loss range by condition, crop, stage and severity, turned into dollars

sources.name: FieldWatch condition catalog
sources.gives: Prior odds and evidence weights per condition; the scorer uses these, never the AI

sources.name: Text messages (notify lane)
sources.gives: Texts to people on the farm; quiet hours and the daily cap are enforced there
used_by: Repair ticket with a map pin

sources.name: AgentCore Memory (past investigations)
sources.gives: What past investigations on this farm found; recalled into the supervisor's prompt, not a tool
